newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares gain in confidence.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares gain in confidence.

text.p: 1720 GMT - Shares closed ended firmer overall, encouraged by the buoyant performance of international bourses, with traders expecting the positive tone to continue on Monday.
*"Investors continue to be optimistic about the outlook for the bourse and as foreign markets are also postive, prices should continue upwards on Monday," said one trader.
*Portugal Telecom issues its results on Wednesday and this is likely to help set the tone for the week, traders said.
*The telecommunications group was 0.08 percent firmer at 6,319 escudos.
*Portucel Industrial suffered some profit-taking after Thursday's strong rise.
*Semapa was one of the session's strongest gainers, advancing 2.9 percent to 3,520 after the company announced on Thursday evening that net profit doubled last year to 3.7 billion escudos.
